theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂
  · exact ⟨_, h₂, .refl _⟩
  · cases h₂
    · exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_I _⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
    · rename_i hc hp
      exact ⟨_, hp, I_irreducible _ hc ▸ .red_I _⟩
  · cases h₂
    · exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_K ..⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
    · rename_i hx hy
      obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ hx
      exact ⟨_, hp, .red_K ..⟩
  · cases h₂
    · exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_S ..⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
    · rename_i hx hy
      obtain ⟨p, q, hp, hq, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ hx
      exact ⟨_, .par (.par hp hy) (.par hq hy), .red_S ..⟩
  · rename_i ha hb ia ib
    cases h₂
    · exact ⟨_, .refl _, .par ha hb⟩
    · exact ⟨_, I_irreducible _ ha ▸ .red_I _, hb⟩
    · obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
      exact ⟨_, .red_K .., hp⟩
    · obtain ⟨p, q, hp, hq, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ha
      exact ⟨_, .red_S .., .par (.par hp hb) (.par hq hb)⟩
    · rename_i hx hy
      obtain ⟨p, p₁, p₂⟩ := ia hx
      obtain ⟨q, q₁, q₂⟩ := ib hy
      exact ⟨_, .par p₁ q₁, .par p₂ q₂⟩

theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  intro d e f ⟨hde, hef⟩
  have key (u v : Fin 9 → ℤ) i :
      digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then v j else u j) = digits_to_num u + (v i - u i) * 10^i.1 :=
    sub_eq_iff_eq_add'.mp <| by
      simp only [hdigits_to_num, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ite_mul, ite_sub, sub_mul, sub_self,
        Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
  have A := fun i => (((hrelation d e).mp hde).2 i).trans (dvd_of_eq (key d e i))
  have B := fun i => (((hrelation e f).mp hef).2 i).trans (dvd_of_eq (key e f i))
  have hsum2 : ∑ i, (digits_to_num d + (e i - d i) * 10^i.1)
      = 7 * digits_to_num d + (digits_to_num e + digits_to_num d) := by
    simp only [hdigits_to_num, Finset.sum_add_distrib, sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_fin]
    ring
  have C : 7 ∣ digits_to_num e + digits_to_num d :=
    (dvd_add_right (dvd_mul_right 7 _)).mp ((Finset.dvd_sum fun i _ => A i).trans (dvd_of_eq hsum2))
  intro i
  exact ((by norm_num : IsCoprime (7 : ℤ) 10).pow_right).dvd_of_dvd_mul_right
    (((C.sub (B i)).sub (A i)).trans (dvd_of_eq (by ring)))

lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let C : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra := [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF
  let q := 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
  have hC0 : C = ofCrAnListF [φ, ψ] - q • ofCrAnListF [ψ, φ] := by
    dsimp only [C, q]
    rw [← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton, superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF]
    simp only [List.singleton_append, ofList_singleton]
  have hcen : ∀ x, x * ι C = ι C * x :=
    Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ)
  have key (φs' φs : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) :
      ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF φs' * C * ofCrAnListF φs) = ι (C * 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF φs' * ofCrAnListF φs)) := by
    let σ := crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs)
    have hmid (l l' : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) :
        ofCrAnListF l * C * ofCrAnListF l' =
        ofCrAnListF (l ++ [φ, ψ] ++ l') - q • ofCrAnListF (l ++ [ψ, φ] ++ l') := by
      rw [hC0]
      simp only [mul_sub, sub_mul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc,
        ← ofCrAnListF_append]
    let A := List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
      (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs)) ++
      List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) φs'
    let B := List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) φs ++
      List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)
      (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs))
    have hall (l : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp)
        (hl : ∀ c ∈ l, crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) :
        crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ l ++ φs) = A ++ l ++ B := by
      rw [crAnTimeOrderList, insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' l φs hl]
      dsimp only [A, B]
      simp only [List.append_assoc]
    have h3 : crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ φs) = A ++ B := by
      simpa only [List.append_nil, List.nil_append] using hall [] (by simp)
    have hsg : crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ [ψ, φ] ++ φs) = σ := by
      simp only [σ, List.append_assoc]
      exact (crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ φs' φs).symm
    have hrt : ι (C * 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF φs' * ofCrAnListF φs)) =
        crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φs) • (ι C * (ι (ofCrAnListF A) * ι (ofCrAnListF B))) := by
      rw [← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, h3, map_mul, map_smul,
        Algebra.mul_smul_comm, ofCrAnListF_append, map_mul]
    calc ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF φs' * C * ofCrAnListF φs)
      _ = σ • (ι (ofCrAnListF (A ++ [φ, ψ] ++ B)) - q • ι (ofCrAnListF (A ++ [ψ, φ] ++ B))) := by

theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  unfold fiberwiseClose at h_fw_dist_lt
  unfold hammingClose
  have hi1 : (i : ℕ) < ℓ + 1 := fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_one i
  have hir : (i : ℕ) < r := fin_ℓ_lt_r (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) i
  let C_i := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, hi1⟩
  let d_fw := fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β (i := i) steps h_i_add_steps f
  let d_s := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i.val + steps, fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_one i steps h_i_add_steps⟩
  let d_i := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i, hi1⟩
  let Y (g : OracleFunction 𝔽q β ⟨i, hi1⟩) := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g
  obtain ⟨g', hg', h_fw⟩ : ∃ g' ∈ C_i, d_fw = (Y g').ncard := by
    obtain ⟨u, _, hu⟩ := (Set.mem_image _ _ _).mp (Nat.sInf_mem
      (Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty : ((fun (u : ↥C_i) => (Y ↑u).ncard) '' Set.univ).Nonempty))
    exact ⟨u, u.property, hu.symm⟩
  have h3 : (d_s - 1) * 2 ^ steps = d_i - 1 := by
    dsimp only [d_s, d_i, BBF_CodeDistance]
    have e (X : ℕ) (h : ↑i + steps ≤ X) : X - (↑i + steps) + steps = X - ↑i := by
      rw [← Nat.sub_add_comm h, Nat.add_sub_add_right]
    rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel, Nat.sub_mul, ← Nat.pow_add,
      e (ℓ + 𝓡) (Nat.le_trans h_i_add_steps (Nat.le_add_right _ _)), ← Nat.pow_add,
      e ℓ h_i_add_steps, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  have h5 : 2 * (d_fw * 2 ^ steps) ≤ d_i - 1 := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← h3]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_pred_of_lt (ENat.coe_lt_coe.mp h_fw_dist_lt))
  letI : Fintype ↥(Y g') := Fintype.ofFinite _
  let π := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps
  let idx := pointToIterateQuotientIndex 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := ⟨i, hi1⟩) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps)
  have key : ∀ x, qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, hir⟩) steps
      (fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps) (π x) (idx x) = x :=
    fun x => (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps
      (x := x) (y := π x)).mp rfl
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun x => (π x, idx x)) := by
    intro x y h
    have hπ : π x = π y := by simpa using congrArg Prod.fst h
    have hi : idx x = idx y := by simpa using congrArg Prod.snd h
    rw [← key x, ← key y, hπ, hi]
  have h_card : hammingDist f g' ≤ d_fw * 2 ^ steps := by
    rw [h_fw, Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card']
    calc hammingDist f g'
        = (Finset.univ.filter (fun x => f x ≠ g' x)).card := rfl
      _ = (Finset.image (fun x => (π x, idx x))
          (Finset.univ.filter fun x => f x ≠ g' x)).card :=
          (Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hinj).symm
      _ ≤ ((Y g').toFinset ×ˢ Finset.univ).card :=
        Finset.card_le_card (Finset.image_subset_iff.mpr
          fun x hx => Finset.mem_product.mpr
            ⟨Set.mem_toFinset.mpr ⟨x, rfl, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2⟩, Finset.mem_univ _⟩)
      _ = (Y g').toFinset.card * 2 ^ steps := by
        rw [Finset.card_product, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
  have h_bridge : Code.distFromCode f C_i ≤ d_fw * 2 ^ steps :=
    (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem (C := C_i) f g' hg').trans (ENat.coe_le_coe.mpr h_card)
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt (mul_le_mul_right h_bridge (2 : ℕ∞))
    (ENat.coe_lt_coe.mpr (Nat.lt_of_le_pred (Nat.succ_pos _) h5))

lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hA2 : ContDiff ℝ 2 A := hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)
  have hA3 : ContDiff ℝ 3 A := hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)
  have hc : 𝓕.c ^ 2 = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) := by rw [FreeSpace.c_sq, mul_comm 𝓕.ε₀ 𝓕.μ₀]
  have hβ : 1 / 𝓕.ε₀ = 𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ := by rw [hc]; field_simp
  have hJ1 : Differentiable ℝ J := hJ.differentiable (by simp)
  have hE : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun y => A.electricField 𝓕.c t y j) :=
    fun j => electricField_apply_contDiff_space hA3 t
  have hEd : ∀ j k, Differentiable ℝ (∂[k] (fun y => A.electricField 𝓕.c t y j)) :=
    fun j k => Space.deriv_differentiable (hE j) k
  have hB : ∀ j, Differentiable ℝ (fun s => ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s · (j, i)) x) :=
    fun j => Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff A hA3 (j, i)) x
  have hJt : Differentiable ℝ (fun s => J.currentDensity 𝓕.c s x i) :=
    LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time hJ1 x i
  have hJc : Differentiable ℝ (fun y => J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t y) :=
    LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space hJ1 t
  have hb : ∀ j, ∂ₜ (fun s => ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s · (j, i)) x) t
      = ∂[j] (fun y => ∂ₜ (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c · y (j, i)) t) x :=
    fun j => Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff A hA3 (j, i)) t x
  have hm : ∀ j y, ∂ₜ (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c · y (j, i)) t
      = ∂[j] (fun z => A.electricField 𝓕.c t z i) y - ∂[i] (fun z => A.electricField 𝓕.c t z j) y :=
    fun j y => time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix A hA2 t y j i
  have hlin {g : Fin d → Time → ℝ} {k : Time → ℝ} (a b : ℝ)
      (hg : ∀ j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (g j) t) (hk : DifferentiableAt ℝ k t) :
      ∂ₜ (fun s => a * ∑ j, g j s - b * k s) t = a * ∑ j, ∂ₜ (g j) t - b * ∂ₜ k t := by
    have h2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun s => ∑ j, g j s) t := DifferentiableAt.fun_sum fun j _ => hg j
    simp only [Time.deriv_eq, fderiv_fun_sub (h2.const_mul a) (hk.const_mul b),
      fderiv_const_mul h2 a, fderiv_const_mul hk b, fderiv_fun_sum fun j _ => hg j,
      FunLike.coe_sub, FunLike.coe_sum, Pi.sub_apply, Finset.sum_apply, _root_.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have hsub (f g : Space d → ℝ) (j : Fin d) (hf : Differentiable ℝ f) (hg : Differentiable ℝ g)
      (x : Space d) : ∂[j] (fun y => f y - g y) x = ∂[j] f x - ∂[j] g x :=
    congrFun (Space.deriv_sub f g hf hg) x
  have hsum {h : Fin d → Space d → ℝ} (i : Fin d) (x : Space d)
      (hh : ∀ j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (h j) x) :
      ∑ j, ∂[i] (h j) x = ∂[i] (fun y => ∑ j, h j y) x := by
    simp only [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis, fderiv_fun_sum fun j _ => hh j, FunLike.coe_sum,
      Finset.sum_apply]
  have hg : ∂[i] (fun y => ∑ j, ∂[j] (fun z => A.electricField 𝓕.c t z j) y) x
      = 𝓕.ε₀⁻¹ * ∂[i] (fun y => J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t y) x := by
    have hd : (fun y => ∑ j, ∂[j] (fun z => A.electricField 𝓕.c t z j) y)
        = fun y => J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t y / 𝓕.ε₀ := by
      show (∇ ⬝ A.electricField 𝓕.c t) = _
      funext y
      exact ((isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h t y).1
    rw [hd]
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis,
      fderiv_mul_const (hJc.differentiableAt) 𝓕.ε₀⁻¹, _root_.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have h4 : ∑ j, ∂[j] (fun y => ∂[j] (fun z => A.electricField 𝓕.c t z i) y
      - ∂[i] (fun z => A.electricField 𝓕.c t z j) y) x
      = ∑ j, ∂[j] (fun y => ∂[j] (fun z => A.electricField 𝓕.c t z i) y) x
        - ∂[i] (fun y => ∑ j, ∂[j] (fun z => A.electricField 𝓕.c t z j) y) x := by
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => hsub _ _ j (hEd i j) (hEd j i) x, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
      Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => congrFun (Space.deriv_commute _ (hE j)) x,
      hsum (hh := fun j => (hEd j j).differentiableAt)]
  have h1 : ∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)
      = fun s => 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s · (j, i)) x
        - 1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * J.currentDensity 𝓕.c s x i := by
    funext s
    rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time hA2 x),
      time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
  rw [h1, hlin (1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀)) (1 / 𝓕.ε₀) (fun j => (hB j).differentiableAt) hJt.differentiableAt]
  simp only [hb, hm]
  rw [h4, mul_sub, hg, ← mul_assoc, ← hc, hβ, div_eq_mul_inv]

        exact ⟨_, .abs v.lc w⟩

    · exact ⟨_, .appₗ r.wf.2.1 h⟩
  case tapp d s i=>

      · exact ⟨_, by cases v; apply Red.case_inl <;> grind⟩
      · exact ⟨_, by cases v; apply Red.case_inr <;> grind⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .case h (by grind) (by grind)⟩

          Fin.snoc (fun i => r i.castSucc) (r (Fin.last (ϑ_sub_2 + 1))) = r :=
        fun _ => Fin.snoc_init_self _

theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n) := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  have hs (n : ℕ) : (u (n+4) : ℝ) = (u (n+3) + u (n+2) + u (n+1) * u n) / (u (n+3) * u (n+2) + u (n+1) + u n) := (hu (n+4) (by omega)).1
  let f := fun n => (u n, u (n+1), u (n+2), u (n+3))
  have fs := finite_Icc B T
  have hfin : (range f).Finite := (fs.prod (fs.prod (fs.prod fs))).subset (range_subset_iff.mpr fun n => ⟨hB n, hB (n+1), hB (n+2), hB (n+3)⟩)
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, hfij⟩ : ∃ i j : ℕ, i < j ∧ f i = f j := by
    by_contra! hc
    refine not_infinite.mpr hfin (infinite_range_of_injective fun a b hab => ((lt_trichotomy a b).resolve_left fun h => hc a b h hab).resolve_right fun h => hc b a h hab.symm)
  have hH : ∀ m, f (i+m) = f (j+m) := Nat.rec hfij fun m ih => by
    simp only [f, Prod.mk.injEq] at ih ⊢
    have e := hs (i+m)
    simp only [ih, ← hs (j+m), Int.cast_inj] at e
    exact ⟨ih.2.1, ih.2.2.1, ih.2.2.2, e⟩
  exact ⟨i, j-i, by omega, fun n hn =>
    (congrArg u (by omega : n + (j-i) = j + (n-i))).trans ((congrArg Prod.fst (hH (n-i))).symm.trans (congrArg u (Nat.add_sub_cancel' hn)))⟩
